title: Valid Parentheses / Balanced Brackets
description: Given a string containing just the characters (){}[], determine if the input string is valid — every opening bracket has a matching closing bracket of the same type, in the correct order.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string, find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeating characters.

title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings, group the anagrams together. Two strings are anagrams if they contain the same characters in a different order.

title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane's Algorithm)
description: Given an array of integers, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and return that sum.

title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals where each interval is [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings, determine if the second is an anagram of the first — the same characters, in any order, used exactly once each.

title: Implement Array.prototype.some() and every() From Scratch
description: Write your own implementation of Array.prototype.some() and Array.prototype.every(), matching the real methods' short-circuiting behavior and edge cases (sparse arrays, thisArg support).

title: Implement Array.prototype.includes() Handling NaN Correctly
description: Write your own implementation of Array.prototype.includes(), correctly handling the real method's SameValueZero comparison — including the case that trips up a naive === based implementation: finding NaN in an array.

title: Design a Simple In-Memory Key-Value Store With TTL Expiry (Mini-Redis)
description: Design and implement a small in-memory key-value store supporting get/set/delete plus a per-key TTL (time to live) after which a key automatically expires, without leaking memory for expired entries.

title: Implement a Circuit Breaker for Flaky API Calls
description: Implement a circuit breaker wrapper around an async function that calls a flaky API — after enough consecutive failures it should 'open' and fail fast without calling the underlying function, then attempt to 'half-open' and recover after a cooldown.

title: Build a Minimal State Machine Runner (States, Transitions, Guards)
description: Design and implement a small finite-state-machine runner: given a configuration of states, events, and transitions (with optional guard functions), drive an object through valid state changes and reject invalid ones.

title: Build a Simple Client-Side Router That Matches Path Patterns
description: Implement a minimal client-side router that registers path patterns (including dynamic segments like /users/:id) against handler functions, and matches a given URL to the correct handler with its parsed parameters.

title: Implement a Virtualized List That Renders Only Visible Rows
description: You have a list of 100,000 rows to render. Implement list virtualization: only the rows currently visible in the scroll viewport (plus a small buffer) should exist in the DOM at any time.

title: Build a Minimal createStore() (Redux-Lite: dispatch, subscribe, reducers)
description: Implement a minimal state-management store from scratch: createStore(reducer) returning getState, dispatch, and subscribe, with the same core contract as Redux's own createStore.

title: Implement a Basic Regular-Expression Matcher (., *, Backtracking)
description: Implement a simplified regular-expression matcher supporting '.' (matches any single character) and '*' (matches zero or more of the preceding element), matching the entire input string.
